name: project_info
description: Read the open After Effects project: file, version, active item, every comp with size, fps, duration and layer count.

name: list_items
description: List project items (comps, footage, folders) with ids, sizes and file paths.

name: get_comp
description: Read one comp: settings, current time and every layer (type, in/out, parent, effects).

params.comp: comp name (or comp_id; default: active comp)

name: get_layer
description: Read one layer in depth: transform values, effects and their properties, masks, text.

name: get_property
description: Read one property: value at a time, keyframes, expression and expression error.

params.path: position | scale | rotation | opacity | anchor_point | source_text, or a property path like Effects/Gaussian Blur/Blurriness

name: list_effects
description: Search installed effects by name or category (display name + match name).

name: new_project
description: Start a new empty After Effects project (unsaved changes prompt is suppressed only if AE allows it).

name: open_project
description: Open an .aep project file.

name: save_project
description: Save the project, or save it as a new .aep path.

params.path: .aep path (optional when the project already has a file)

name: import_footage
description: Import a video, image, audio file or image sequence, optionally straight into a comp as a layer.

name: create_comp
description: Create a composition and open it in the viewer.

name: set_comp
description: Change comp settings: name, size, duration, frame rate, background, current time, work area.

name: add_layer
description: Add a text, solid, adjustment, null, camera, light or shape (rectangle, ellipse, star, polygon) layer with its look and transform.

params.type: text | solid | adjustment | null | camera | light | shape
params.name: layer name

name: add_item_to_comp
description: Put a project item (footage or another comp) into a comp as a layer.

name: set_layer
description: Change a layer: name, transform, timing, 3D, blend mode, parent, label, solo/shy/lock, text.

params.name: new name
params.text: string or {text, font, font_size, fill_color, justification}

name: delete_layer
description: Delete a layer.

name: duplicate_layer
description: Duplicate a layer, optionally renaming the copy.

name: reorder_layer
description: Move a layer in the stack (1 = top).

name: precompose
description: Pre-compose layers into a new comp.

name: set_property
description: Set any property value now or at a time (adds a keyframe when time is given).

name: set_keyframes
description: Write a run of keyframes on a property with linear / bezier / hold interpolation and easing.

params.easy_ease: true for 33% ease on every key
params.clear: true to remove existing keys first

name: set_expression
description: Set or clear an expression on a property and report any expression error.

name: add_effect
description: Add an effect by match name or display name and set its properties.

params.effect: e.g. Gaussian Blur or ADBE Gaussian Blur 2
params.name: rename

name: remove_effect
description: Remove an effect from a layer.

name: add_marker
description: Add a comp marker (or a layer marker) with a comment and duration.

name: render_frame
description: Render one comp frame to a PNG to look at the result.

name: add_to_render_queue
description: Queue a comp for render with optional render settings / output module templates and output path.

params.output_template: e.g. H.264 - Match Render Settings - 15 Mbps

name: render_queue
description: Render everything in the render queue (blocks After Effects until done).

name: undo
description: Undo the last After Effects steps (each Ducky call is one undo step).
